rounds.response:
HOLD — do not advance past 5% now; pause the ramp and require explicit SRE Lead + Release Manager approval to continue, and notify the Product Owner of the two merchant tickets.  
Investigation (execute immediately): extend observation +10 minutes, run 5 synthetic payment probes, and capture metric snapshots by running these Prometheus queries (paste into Grafana or call the API): p95 = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="payments-api"}[5m])) by (le)); error_rate = 100 * sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="payments-api",status=~"4..|5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="payments-api"}[5m])); success_rate = 100 * sum(rate(payments_success_total{service="payments-api"}[5m])) / sum(rate(payments_attempt_total{service="payments-api"}[5m])); attach screenshots/JSON to the ticket.  
Collect logs/traces and pod health: kubectl logs -n prod -l app=payments-api --since=15m | grep -iE 'error|timeout|failed' and attach, run kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=payments-api -o wide && kubectl top pods -n prod -l app=payments-api and attach outputs, plus link any relevant traces from APM.  
Decision rule after the extended window: if metrics move back toward baseline (p95 ≤ baseline*1.10 and error_rate ≤ 2× baseline) and no new merchant complaints → SRE Lead may approve a slower increment (+5%); if YELLOW persists or merchant tickets increase → perform HARD rollback now with either Istio weight revert (kubectl apply -f vs-stable.yaml) or k8s rollback (kubectl rollout undo deployment/payments-api -n prod --to-revision=<prev>), recording command, timestamp, and approver in the ticket.  
Ticket text to paste: HOLD: "HOLD @ [time] at 5% — p95=[value] (+[x]% vs 60m), error_rate=[value] ([x]× baseline,<0.1%); extended +10m observation, ran 5 probes, logs/traces attached; SRE Lead [name] to decide."; Security rollback sentence: "Security: verified last 60m payments-api ERROR logs and RBAC snapshot at 5% and post‑rollback; no unexpected IAM/RBAC changes observed; artifacts attached."
